verdicts.reason: A: the quote is squeezed onto one tiny line, so the message is close to unreadable. The oversized Monograph logo takes over the frame and flips the hierarchy, and the quote mark has shrunk to almost nothing. B is worse: the attribution 'AIKO TANABE, ARCHITECT' is set wider and heavier than the quote itself. B's tiny one-line quote also runs nearly edge to edge with almost no side margins, and 'GALLERY' under the logo has faded to illegible.
